account_id.description: The account its claim lines cost: an active, postable expense or asset account that is not a money, control or system account.

active.description: false puts it out of use; left out, in use.

attendees_above.description: Above it, a line names who attended; left out, never asked.

limit.description: The most a line of it is, in the base currency; left out, no limit.

mileage.description: Make it the mileage category (one in use at most); never changes once made.

name.description: What its claims are for, unique among the categories in use.

receipt_above.description: Above it, a line needs its receipt; left out, never required.
